CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database

Private Sub Anul_Change()
Call Luna_Change
End Sub

Private Sub Anul_X_Enter()
Anul.SetFocus
Anul.Dropdown
End Sub

Private Sub Command197_Click()

If DCount("IDPL", "Plati", "IDZ=" & Me.IDZ) <> 0 Then
    MsgBox "Acest copil are plati inregistrate!" & vbCrLf & "Pentru a evita eventuale erori, nu se mai poate modifica prezenta lui!", vbOKOnly + vbInformation
    Exit Sub
End If


Call GolesteTabel(, "DatePickerDate")

Dim ctl As Control, RC As Recordset, prev_Ctl As Control

Set RC = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("DatePickerDate", 2)

Dim DI As Date, DSF As Date

Dim ZR As Boolean 'verific daca au ramas zile nesalvate in tabel
Dim Pzp As Boolean 'verific daca este prima zi dintr-un set de prezente
Dim Pza As Boolean 'verific daca este prima zi dintr-un set de absente

Dim i As Integer: i = 0 'contor pentru toate zilele din saptamanta
Dim K As Integer: K = 0 'contor pentru zile prezente
Dim J As Integer: J = 0 'contor pentru zile absente
Dim Z As Integer: Z = 0 'contor pentru zile consecutive

For Each ctl In Me.Detail.Controls
    ZR = False
    If Left(ctl.Name, 1) = "Z" And val(Mid(ctl.Name, 2, 1)) <= 5 And ctl.visible = True Then
        If K = 0 And J = 0 Then DI = CDate(Replace(ctl.ControlTipText, "[AZI]", ""))
        If CBool(ctl.Tag) Then
            If K = 0 Then Pzp = True
            K = K + 1
        Else
            If J = 0 Then Pza = True
            J = J + 1
        End If
        
        i = i + 1

        If K <> 0 And K <> i And Not Pzp Then 'daca s-au numarat zilele prezente si difera de cat ar trebui sa fie
            DSF = CDate(Replace(prev_Ctl.ControlTipText, "[AZI]", ""))
            RC.AddNew
                RC!IDZ = IDZ
                RC!DI = DI
                RC!DSF = DSF
                RC!nrzile = Z
            RC.Update
            K = 0
            i = 0
            Z = 0
            DI = CDate(Replace(ctl.ControlTipText, "[AZI]", ""))
            i = 1
        End If
        
        If J <> 0 And J <> i And Not Pza Then 'daca s-au numarat zilele prezente si difera de cat ar trebui sa fie
            DSF = CDate(Replace(prev_Ctl.ControlTipText, "[AZI]", ""))
            RC.AddNew
                RC!IDZ = IDZ
                RC!DI = DI
                RC!DSF = DSF
                RC!nrzile = Z
                RC!absent = True
            RC.Update
            J = 0
            i = 0
            Z = 0
            DI = CDate(Replace(ctl.ControlTipText, "[AZI]", ""))
            i = 1
        End If
       
        If J <> 0 Or K <> 0 Then
            Z = Z + 1
            If J <> 0 Then Pza = False
            If K <> 0 Then Pzp = False
        End If
        
        Set prev_Ctl = ctl
    End If
    ZR = True
Next

If ZR Then
    DSF = CDate(Replace(prev_Ctl.ControlTipText, "[AZI]", ""))
    RC.AddNew
        RC!IDZ = IDZ
        RC!DI = DI
        RC!DSF = DSF
        RC!nrzile = Z
        RC!absent = IIf(J <> 0, True, False)
    RC.Update
End If

Set ctl = Nothing
Set prev_Ctl = Nothing

If IDZ <> -1 Then
    Call TransferaDateZile(IDZ)
Else
    Set RC = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("SELECT IDZ FROM Prezenta_L", 2)
    POP RC
    Do While Not RC.EOF
        If RC!IDZ <> 0 Then Call TransferaDateZile(RC!IDZ)
        RC.MoveNext
    Loop
End If

Set RC = Nothing

If IsLoaded("Prezenta") Then
    Forms!prezenta!Prezenta_sub.Requery
    DoCmd.Close acForm, Me.Name
End If

End Sub

Sub TransferaDateZile(ByVal IDZ As Integer)
Dim RC As Recordset, TC As Recordset, xc As Recordset
Dim ZileLuna As Integer: ZileLuna = DLookup("ZileLuna", "Prezenta_L", "IDZ=" & IDZ)
Dim tDetalii As String
Dim IDV As Integer: IDV = DLookup("IDV", "Prezenta_L", "IDZ=" & IDZ)

Set RC = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("DatePickerDate", 2)
Set TC = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("SELECT * FROM Prezenta_sub_l where IDZ=" & IDZ, 2)
Set xc = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("SELECT * FROM ValoriTaxe WHERE IDV = " & IDV, 2)

If RC.EOF Then 'daca s-a sters toata prezenta copilului o marchez ca stearsa in tabelul [Prezenta_sub_L] ca apoi sa o sterg din [Prezenta_sub]
    Do While Not TC.EOF
        TC.Edit
            TC!Sters = True
        TC.Update
        TC.MoveNext
    Loop
    
    GoTo Finish
End If
  
Call GolesteTabel(TC)

Do While Not RC.EOF
    TC.AddNew
        TC!idx = Nz(DMax("IDX", "prezenta_sub_l"), Nz(DMax("IDX", "Prezenta_sub"), 0)) + 1
        TC!IDZ = IDZ
        TC!IDL = Forms!prezenta!IDL
        TC!DI = RC!DI
        TC!DSF = RC!DSF
        TC!nrzile = RC!nrzile
        TC!absent = RC!absent
        If Nz(DLookup("IDZ", "Prezenta", "IDZ=" & IDZ), 0) <> 0 Then TC!Editat = True
    TC.Update
    RC.MoveNext
Loop

Set TC = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("SELECT * FROM Prezenta_L WHERE IDZ=" & IDZ, 2)
    TC.Edit
        TC!ZilePrezenta = Nz(DSum("Nrzile", "DatePickerDate", "Absent=False"), 0)
        TC!ZileAbsenta = Nz(DSum("Nrzile", "DatePickerDate", "Absent=True"), 0)
        TC!MZCPrezenta = Nz(DMax("Nrzile", "DatePickerDate", "Absent=False"), 0)
        TC!MZCAbsenta = Nz(DMax("Nrzile", "DatePickerDate", "Absent=true"), 0)
        
        TC!Restanta = Nz(DSum("ValoareTotala", "Prezenta", "IDP=" & TC!IDP & " AND IDL < " & TC!IDL), 0) - Nz(DSum("Plata", "Plati", "IDP=" & TC!IDP & " AND IDL < " & TC!IDL & " AND Anulata = False"), 0)
        
        If xc!DoarCalculZilnic Then 'pentru unitatile bugetare care nu calculeaza decat valoare zilnica
            TC!ValoareContract = TC!ZilePrezenta * xc!TaxaZilnica
            TC!ValoareMancare = 0
            TC!ReducereFrate = 0
            TC!Avans = 0
            If Nz(DLookup("IDZ", "Prezenta", "IDP=" & DLookup("IDP", "Prezenta_L", "IDZ=" & IDZ)), 0) = 0 Then
                TC!SI = Nz(DLookup("si", "Platitori", "IDP=" & DLookup("IDP", "Prezenta_L", "IDZ=" & IDZ)), 0)
            End If
            tDetalii = "Prezenta  " & TC!ZilePrezenta & " zile."
            If TC!Restanta > 0 Then tDetalii = tDetalii & vbCrLf & "Restanta " & TC!Restanta & " lei!"
        Else
            'daca este prezent maximum de [ZilePre] -> [ValoriTaxe] zile, se calculeaza valoarea / zi
            If TC!ZilePrezenta <= xc!ZilePre Then
                TC!ValoareContract = (xc!TaxaZilnica * TC!ZilePrezenta) - (TC!ZilePrezenta * (xc!taxamicdejun + xc!taxadejun))
                tDetalii = "Prezenta < " & CInt(DLookup("ZilePre", "ValoriTaxe", "Activ=True")) & " zile. Calcul valoare zilnica!"
            Else
                If TC!MZCAbsenta >= xc!ZileCon Then
                    'daca lipseste [zileCon]->[ValoriTaxe] zile consecutive, se aplica discount [DisCon] -> [ValoriTaxe]
                    TC!ValoareContract = (xc!TaxaLunara - (ZileLuna * (xc!taxamicdejun + xc!taxadejun)))
                    TC!ValoareContract = TC!ValoareContract - (TC!ValoareContract * xc!DisCon)
                    tDetalii = IIf(tDetalii <> "", tDetalii & vbCrLf, "") & "Absent " & TC!MZCAbsenta & " zile! Reducere " & Format(xc!DisCon, "Percent") & "!"
                Else
                    'daca este o luna normala, trec valoarea [TaxaLunara] -> [ValoriTaxe]
                    TC!ValoareContract = xc!TaxaLunara - (ZileLuna * (xc!taxamicdejun + xc!taxadejun))
                    tDetalii = IIf(tDetalii <> "", tDetalii & vbCrLf, "") & "Calcul luna intreag�!"
                End If
            End If
        
            'valoare mancarii zilnice
            TC!ValoareMancare = (xc!taxamicdejun + xc!taxadejun) * TC!ZilePrezenta
            
            'discount frate
            If CBool(Nz(DLookup("Frate", "Platitori", "IDP=" & DLookup("IDP", "Prezenta_L", "IDZ=" & IDZ)), False)) = True And TC!ZilePrezenta > xc!ZilePre Then
                TC!ReducereFrate = TC!ValoareContract * xc!DisBro
                tDetalii = IIf(tDetalii <> "", tDetalii & vbCrLf, "") & "Reducere " & xc!DisBro & "% frate!"
            End If
            
            'daca este prima luna a copilului, caut sa vad daca a platit avans
            If DCount("IDZ", "Prezenta", "IDP=" & DLookup("IDP", "Prezenta_L", "IDZ=" & IDZ)) = 0 Then
                TC!Avans = Nz(DLookup("Avans", "Platitori", "IDP=" & DLookup("IDP", "Prezenta_L", "IDZ=" & IDZ)), 0)
                TC!SI = Nz(DLookup("si", "Platitori", "IDP=" & DLookup("IDP", "Prezenta_L", "IDZ=" & IDZ)), 0)
                If TC!Avans <> 0 Then tDetalii = IIf(tDetalii <> "", tDetalii & vbCrLf, "") & "Avans scazut din contract!"
            End If
        End If
        
        TC!ValoareTotala = TC!ValoareContract + TC!ValoareMancare + TC!SI - TC!ReducereFrate - TC!Avans + TC!Restanta
        TC!Detalii = tDetalii
    TC.Update

Finish:
Set RC = Nothing
Set TC = Nothing
Set xc = Nothing

End Sub

Private Sub Form_Load()
'Me.FormFooter.visible = False
Me.IDZ = Nz(Me.OpenArgs, 0)

FOC.SetFocus
LunaX.Enabled = True
Anul_X.Enabled = True
Luna_prev.Enabled = True
Luna_next.Enabled = True

DA = True 'daca dezactivez [DA] dezactivez click-ul pe zile

Luna = Month(Now())
Anul = Year(Now())
Dt = Replace(RemoveTimeFromDate(Now()), ".", "/")
    
Dim i As Integer
Luna.RowSource = ""
For i = 1 To 12
    Luna.AddItem i & ";" & fLuna(Trim(Str(i)))
Next i

Luna = Forms!prezenta!Luna

Luna.Requery

Dim ctl As Control
For Each ctl In Me.Controls
    If Left(ctl.Name, 1) = "Z" Then ctl.visible = False
Next

S6.visible = False
SL = False

Call Luna_Change

Select Case Me.IDZ
    Case Is <> 0
        Call PreiaDatePrezenta
        Call ColoreazaButoane
End Select



End Sub

Sub PreiaDatePrezenta()
Dim RC As Recordset, TC As Recordset
Set TC = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("SELECT * FROM Prezenta_sub_l WHERE IDZ = " & Me.IDZ, 2)
Set RC = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("DatePickerDate", 2)

Call GolesteTabel(RC)


Luna = DLookup("Luna", "LunaD_L", "IDL = " & Forms!prezenta!IDL)
LunaX.Enabled = False
Anul = DLookup("Anul", "LunaD_L", "IDL = " & Forms!prezenta!IDL)
Anul_X.Enabled = False
Luna_prev.Enabled = False
Luna_next.Enabled = False

If TC.EOF Then GoTo Finish

POP TC

Do While Not TC.EOF
    RC.AddNew
        RC!DI = TC!DI
        RC!DSF = TC!DSF
        RC!IDZ = TC!IDZ
        RC!absent = TC!absent
        RC!nrzile = TC!nrzile
    RC.Update
    TC.MoveNext
Loop

Finish:
Set TC = Nothing
Set RC = Nothing

End Sub

Private Sub Luna_Change()
Dim ctl As Control
For Each ctl In Me.Controls
    If Left(ctl.Name, 1) = "Z" Then
        ctl.visible = False
        ctl.Caption = ctl.Name
        ctl.Enabled = True
    End If
Next

S6.visible = False

Dim NrZi As Integer, vData As Date
Dim CurrWeek As Byte: CurrWeek = 1
Dim vNow As Date: vNow = RemoveTimeFromDate(Nz(Data, Now()))

For i = 1 To dhDaysInMonth("01/" & Luna & "/" & Anul)
    vData = DateValue(Format(i & "/" & Luna & "/" & Anul, "DD/MM/YYYY", vbMonday))
    NrZi = Weekday(vData, vbMonday)
    If NrZi = 7 Then CurrWeek = CurrWeek + 1
    If NrZi >= 1 And NrZi <= 6 And CurrWeek = 6 Then S6.visible = True
    Me.Controls("Z" & NrZi & "_" & CurrWeek).Caption = Day(vData)
    Me.Controls("Z" & NrZi & "_" & CurrWeek).visible = True
    
    If NrZi = 6 Or NrZi = 7 Then
        Me.Controls("Z" & NrZi & "_" & CurrWeek).OnClick = "=MsgBox('Ziua este dezactivata (Weekend)', 16, 'WEEKEND')" '"" - daca vreau sa dezactivez zilele de weekend, sau "mcrDateSelect" daca vreau activ
        Me.Controls("Z" & NrZi & "_" & CurrWeek).ForeColor = RGB(255, 0, 0)
        Me.Controls("Z" & NrZi & "_" & CurrWeek).ControlTipText = "WEEKEND"
    Else
        Me.Controls("Z" & NrZi & "_" & CurrWeek).OnMouseUp = "mcrDateSelect"
        Me.Controls("Z" & NrZi & "_" & CurrWeek).ControlTipText = vData 'Me.Controls("LZ_" & NrZi).Caption & ", " & Me.Controls("Z" & NrZi & "_" & CurrWeek).Caption & "/" & Luna.Column(1) & "/" & Anul
        If CInt(Split(Access.Version, ".")(0)) > 12 Then
            Me.Controls("Z" & NrZi & "_" & CurrWeek).BackColor = RGB(255, 255, 255)
            Me.Controls("Z" & NrZi & "_" & CurrWeek).ForeColor = RGB(0, 0, 0)
        End If
    End If
Next i

For Each ctl In Me.Controls
    If Left(ctl.Name, 1) = "Z" Then
        ctl.FontBold = False
        
        If ctl.Caption = Trim(CStr(Day(vNow))) And ctl.Enabled = True And Trim(CStr(Month(vNow))) = CStr(Luna) Then
            If CInt(Split(Access.Version, ".")(0)) > 12 Then ctl.BackColor = RGB(150, 150, 200)
            ctl.SetFocus
            Data = Format(vNow, "dd/mm/yyyy")
        End If
        
        If ctl.Caption = Trim(CStr(Day(Now()))) And ctl.Enabled = True And Trim(CStr(Month(Now()))) = CStr(Luna) Then
            ctl.ControlTipText = "[AZI] " & ctl.ControlTipText
            ctl.ForeColor = RGB(0, 0, 255)
            ctl.FontBold = True
        End If
    
    End If
Next
    
                
FOC.SetFocus

End Sub

Function dhDaysInMonth(Optional dtmDate As Date = 0) As Integer
    ' Return the number of days in the specified month.
    If dtmDate = 0 Then
        ' Did the caller pass in a date? If not, use
        ' the current date.
        dtmDate = Date
    End If
    dhDaysInMonth = DateSerial(Year(dtmDate), _
     Month(dtmDate) + 1, 1) - _
     DateSerial(Year(dtmDate), Month(dtmDate), 1)
End Function



Public Function RemoveTimeFromDate(DateTime As Date) As Date


    Dim dblNumber As Double

    RemoveTimeFromDate = CDate(Floor(CDbl(DateTime)))

End Function

Private Function Floor(ByVal x As Double, Optional ByVal Factor As Double = 1) As Double
    Floor = Int(x / Factor) * Factor
End Function

Private Sub ok_Click()
DoCmd.Close acForm
End Sub

Private Sub Luna_next_Click()
If Luna = 12 Then
    Luna = 1
    Anul = Anul + 1
Else
    Luna = Luna + 1
End If

Call Luna_Change

End Sub

Private Sub Luna_prev_Click()
If Luna = 1 Then
    Luna = 12
    Anul = Anul - 1
Else
    Luna = Luna - 1
End If

Call Luna_Change

End Sub

Private Sub LunaX_Enter()
Luna.SetFocus
Luna.Dropdown

End Sub

Private Sub SL_Click()
Dim ctl As Control
For Each ctl In Me.Detail.Controls
    If Left(ctl.Name, 1) = "z" Then
        If CInt(Mid(ctl.Name, 2, 1)) <= 5 Then 'doar zilele saptamanii
            ctl.Tag = SL
            If SL Then ctl.BackColor = RGB(0, 255, 0) Else ctl.BackColor = RGB(255, 255, 255)
        End If
    End If
Next

Set ctl = Nothing
                
        
End Sub

Private Sub ColoreazaButoane()
Dim ctl As Control

Dim RC As Recordset: Set RC = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("DatePickerDate", 2)

Dim DI As Date, DSF As Date, DCur As Date

POP RC

Do While Not RC.EOF
    For DCur = RC!DI To RC!DSF
        For Each ctl In Me.Detail.Controls
            If Left(ctl.Name, 1) = "Z" Then
                If CInt(Mid(ctl.Name, 2, 1)) <= 5 And ctl.visible = True Then
                    If CDate(Replace(ctl.ControlTipText, "[AZI]", "")) = DCur Then
                        ctl.BackColor = IIf(RC!absent, RGB(255, 255, 255), RGB(0, 255, 0))
                        ctl.Tag = Not RC!absent
                    End If
                End If
            End If
        Next
    Next
    RC.MoveNext
Loop

Finish:
Set ctl = Nothing
Set RC = Nothing

End Sub
